# olivares_deployment (Data Source)

Reads a deployment definition's governed state (module VII), read-only. Requires deploy:deployment:read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "olivares_deployment" "billing_prod" {
  id = olivares_deployment.billing_prod.id
}

output "applied_version" {
  value = data.olivares_deployment.billing_prod.applied_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The deployment definition id to read.

### Optional

- `tenant` (String) Tenant UUID, overriding the provider-level tenant. Sent as X-Olivares-Tenant.

### Read-Only

- `applied_version` (Number) Revision actually reconciled (real); 0 = never applied.
- `current_version` (Number) Latest declared revision (desired).
- `desired_status` (String) active | retired.
- `environment` (String) Deployment environment.
- `name` (String) Logical deployment name.
- `runtime` (String) Executor/runtime kind.
- `source_ref` (String) GitOps source reference.
- `spec_hash` (String) Hex SHA-256 of the current desired spec.
- `subject_kind` (String) agent | mcp_server.
- `subject_ref` (String) Logical reference of the deployed subject.
- `target` (String) Runtime target reference.
